# caseclosed

> caseclosed (caseclosedme.com) is a UAE-based online store for anime figures,
> Funko Pops, collectibles, and acrylic phone-case protectors. Prices are in AED
> and include VAT. Flat-rate delivery of AED 20 across the UAE. Payments and
> checkout run on Shopify.

## What we sell

- Anime figures (One Piece, Naruto, Dragon Ball, Jujutsu Kaisen, Demon Slayer, Bleach, and more): https://caseclosedme.com/search
- Funko Pops (anime, Marvel, WWE, Harry Potter): https://caseclosedme.com/search/funko-pop
- Acrylic protectors for Funko Pops: https://caseclosedme.com/search/protectors
- Best sellers: https://caseclosedme.com/search/best-sellers

## Facts

- Region served: United Arab Emirates (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and all Emirates)
- Currency: AED (prices VAT-inclusive)
- Delivery: flat AED 20 across the UAE (Cash on Delivery: AED 30 — AED 20 delivery plus a AED 10 handling fee)
- Contact: https://caseclosedme.com/contact
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/caseclosed.me
